off: Pictures: off. They would share the card with chat, and this choice keeps the card for chat alone.

Pictures take turns with chat: a message with a picture unloads chat for a moment (qwen2.5vl:3b needs 3.66 GB on its own), and chat loads again on your next message. That costs a few seconds each way (not measured).
